answer: Treat identity like a coral reef built from several unrelated species: a seat earns full pay only after linking proofs from three independent verifiers run by different groups, say a phone check, a paid API account, and a vouch from another network. Each epoch pulse, their revocation lists are re-synced and losing any proof cuts pay by a third. A farm must beat three separate defenses per seat, and the cost delta grows with every verifier added.
